parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paging query.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for the elasticity assurance query. Obtain the value from the result of the previous request.

parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.Id
parameters.description: The ID of the elasticity assurance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the elasticity assurance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
